violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5607(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: During transportation the following children in care were observed as follows: One boy was observed on his knees looking out the window, a girl was hugging the front seat by the driver without a seat belt, and three other girls were also observed without seatbelts.

finding_variants.text: During transportation the following children in care were observed as follows: One boy was observed on his knees looking out the window, a girl was hugging the front seat by the driver without a seat belt, and three other girls were also observed without seatbelts.
Based on the DFPS investigation there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the car seat that a child was riding in was not properly secured into the vehicle.
Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support that a child was not secured in a passenger safety seat system due to the daycare bus being overloaded.
The operation has three expired child safety seats on one van.     CI: The child safety seats were thrown away during inspection.

During the investigation it was found that children who are too young and small to sit in a vehicle without a booster/car seat were transported without the appropriate seats.  It was also found that more children were transported than the seatbelts available in the vehicle.
Based on interviews and documentation, it was determined that children have been transported without being properly secured in a safety seat system.
